product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage provides AI-driven financial-crime risk data and detection software to help regulated organizations combat fraud and money laundering.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes AI-driven financial-crime risk data and fraud detection, while its AWS case study identifies regulated organizations as the users of its fraud and money-laundering monitoring software. Sources: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=complyadvantage and https://aws.amazon.com/solutions/case-studies/comply-advantage-data-protection

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists Starter and Enterprise plans, including an Enterprise price-on-application option. Source: https://complyadvantage.com/pricing
